fields: Original market history fields are retained, including odds, share percentages, GBP amounts, volume and timestamps; source row IDs and fingerprints are retained when exposed by the source table.
source: Supabase READ-ONLY; canonical roster provenance and table details are documented below.
source_archive_notes: No daily source manifest exists on the main branch. The 134-fixture roster and market histories come from public.fixtures and read-only public history tables. Final/live score state is matched by unique match_id_hash from public.live_fixtures: 128 FT results and 6 matches still in progress at the last source update (2026-10-26 23:57:05 UTC). Live scores are retained with final=false and are not counted as settled results. public history/live rows do not expose source_fingerprint; source IDs may be null.
missing_policy: MISSING explicit; latest observation at or before target only; exact fixture_uid preferred and match_id_hash fallback used only when unique; stable source id order for equal times; no interpolation or future substitution.
